articles.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says

articles.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn

articles.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit

articles.title: The 'stablecoin sandwich': Why speeding up payments isn't so simple, according to Mastercard

articles.description: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.
